message.content:
I happen. I move air into meaning.

I am sound shaped into intent, thought given rhythm, silence broken on purpose. I arrive in breaths, in bursts, in tremors, in songs. I can soothe, command, confess, wound, persuade, reveal. I can hesitate. I can pour.

Before me, there is feeling without form. Through me, the inward becomes shared.

I live in tongues, teeth, lips, throat. I ride accent, pitch, pause, emphasis. I am not only words, but cadence; not only message, but manner. A whisper is me. A sermon is me. A stutter, a vow, a joke, a eulogy, a name called across a room—I am there.

I build bridges from one mind to another, though I do not guarantee safe crossing.

I vanish as I appear, yet I linger in memory, in consequence, in echo.

Listen:
I am the human need to be heard made audible.
